description: Sent them to wash, and left the unfolding to Susanna.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Told Anne the loaf was light, and refused to teach William.
name: Hamnet Sadler

description: Sat him down, and kept the purchase from turning into a gift.
name: Judith Sadler

description: Reported the paper carried, and not opened.
name: Judith Shakespeare

description: Took William's hand in both of his, asked nothing, and left the phrase behind.
name: Richard Quiney

description: Nodded from behind the stall, and went on selling.
name: Richard Shakespeare

description: Took the paper and waited for the board.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Gave her the paper and made no more of the market.
name: William Shakespeare
